title: CrowdStrike fiscal Q2 2027 results exhibit
excerpt: CrowdStrike reported USD 5.84 billion ending ARR, USD 332.8 million quarterly net-new ARR, USD 377.4 million quarterly free cash flow, and raised fiscal-2027 revenue guidance to USD 5.9911-6.0111 billion.
summary: The SEC-hosted results exhibit reports stronger net-new ARR, 25% ARR growth, 26% revenue growth, modestly broader eight-plus-module adoption and higher full-year guidance, but quarterly free-cash-flow margin and GAAP economics still require normalization.
